name: Pandavgad
highlights:
Wai Caves are 9 Buddhist Caves, situated at Lonara, 7 km north of Wai. 
The Chaitya hall containing a Stupa has since been converted into a Shiva temple.

name: Madhu Makarand Gad
highlights: Makrandgad Fort is a fort near Pratapgad Fort. It is located 156km from Pune, in Satara district, of Maharashtra. The fort is located in the midst of the famous Javli forest. The fort is accessible from the Hatlot and Ghonaspur village. The trek to this fort is an easy one day trek for visitors at Mahabaleshwar. The fort consists of two flattened humps with a ridge between them.
